crossRefs.note: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of…
It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’
that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of Yahweh’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in…
Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart…
the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will…
We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
translations.bsb: And on that day you are to explain to your son, ‘This is because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
translations.kjv: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.
translations.asv: And thou shalt tell thy son in that day, saying, It is because of that which Jehovah did for me when I came forth out of Egypt.
